3.fullname:
Founded in 1613, Universidad Nacional de Córdoba is one of the oldest universities in the Americas and a prestigious center for academic excellence in Latin America. Located in the vibrant city of Córdoba, Argentina, UNC offers a rich cultural experience, world-class education, and a lively student community.

An exchange agreement between UNC (Faculty of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences) and Aalto University technical schools was established in 2023.

Studies and making your study plan
All courses are available provided that the students have the  necessary background and level of studies. As a guidance,  courses from 1st, 2nd and 3rd year correspond to bachelor-level; courses from 4th and 5th year correspond to master level. 
International students can take courses from different programs and different years.

The RTF credit system applied at FCEFyN-UNC is based on the following equivalence: 1 RTF credit = 30 hours of total work. 
1 full semester represents approximately 30 RTF credits.

Language requirements
At present, all courses are taught in Spanish. B1 level is required
